model.name: Calibrate trace-audit orphan metric to be meaningful
model.scheduleNote: Metric is reported-only (not hard-gated); planner schedules, likely S28. R27.4 proceeds FIRST + is insulated (METHOD-scoped gate).
model.description: Calibrate the trace-audit orphan metric so a non-zero count means REAL chain debt, not benign data. Today it reports ~2207 orphans by walking forward from Requirement roots via CANONICAL_FORWARD (Requirement->useCases, NOT tasks) over ALL unit types - so every Task + all non-chain data (TestCase/Device/File/Room/Skill/Bug/Phone/Profile) is counted 'orphan' and the number can NEVER reach 0. Fix: (1) add the non-chain unit types to ORPHAN_BY_DESIGN_TYPES (excluded from reachability), (2) add Requirement->tasks to CANONICAL_FORWARD + walk from Sprint roots (Sprint->tasks/requirements) to close the ~382-unit walk-gap. Expected: ~2207 -> real-chain-orphans only, making the instrument trustworthy.
model.tronQuote: > Derived from reconciling the trace-audit 2207-orphan metric vs R27.4's 51 orphan-Methods; PO ratified capture 2026-07-01. Make the INSTRUMENT honest.

discoverySource.measured: ~2207 audit-orphans = ~1600 benign non-chain (TestCase/Device/File/Room/... never-0) + ~382 walk-gap (Requirement->useCases not tasks -> all Tasks counted) + small overlap with the 51 real Method-orphans. The metric over-counts benign data + a walk-gap -> misleading.

model.crossRefNote: R27.4 fixes the 51 REAL orphan-Methods (the defect); R27.5 fixes the METRIC that over-counts (the instrument). R24.5 owns trace:audit:strict. Order: R27.4 FIRST (insulated by METHOD-scoped gate); R27.5 later calibrates the broad metric so it can eventually be hard-gated honestly.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Non-chain unit types (TestCase/Device/File/Room/Skill/Bug/Phone/Profile/WebItem/Message/Company/Email/User/Gate/CurrentSprint) are added to ORPHAN_BY_DESIGN_TYPES so they are excluded from the reachability orphan count.
CANONICAL_FORWARD adds Requirement->tasks and the walk also roots from Sprint units (Sprint->tasks/requirements), so Tasks + subtrees are reachable, closing the ~382-unit walk-gap.
After calibration the orphan metric drops from ~2207 to the real chain-orphans only (aligns with R27.4 METHOD-scoped count, ~0 post-R27.4).
A non-zero orphan count now indicates REAL chain debt, not benign non-chain data; the metric becomes trustworthy enough to hard-gate.
Re-run trace:audit post-calibration: benign non-chain data no longer counted; the number reflects only real chain-orphans.
